notes.title: Voxelaxy Remastered
notes.content:
Hello Astronauts! After almost 3 years and a big break on Voxelaxy, I've come back with the biggest Update Voxelaxy has ever seen.I've rewritten everything to bring you new gaming experience! The old game in a new Remastered Version!
For those who have Voxelaxy (it's free - it's just an update), for those who are new, there is a fantastic price! Welcome to the new era of Voxelaxy!

notes.title: Beta Update 3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29894218/1edf8c29f37f60487bb1dc49a03c58c3cc979f7f.png[/img]

Hey!
I've just done the next update.
I've changed a lot.

1. The flashlight was removed. Now the Astronaut has got a headlamp. To turn it on, you have to insert the Battery 9V in the new field in inventory and press L to switch on.
2. New Interaction System - Now you can fast open objects. I mean if you click on an object by pressing LMB you open it or open crafting when you click on it by pressing RMB you see a menu list with all possible actions.
3. Mining system was changed too. Now you must press LMB all the time and just stay forward to the mineral. Mining time was reduced from 4 sec to 1 sec. Remember that a Battery is consumed when you press LMB!
4. I've also changed database system, it means WIPE(Game will destroy your current saves! I'm really sorry but it was necessary).

notes.title: Beta Update 2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29894218/13c36596b6c28460760be6ee4525659074635abc.png[/img]

Hello Astronauts!

In this update, I've changed the system of gameplay and fixed a lot of bugs.


The System of the Gameplay:

I mean, you've been able to respawn in start point of the map. Astronaut didn't have to craft Oxygen, because he could respawn and his tank would be refilled again. After consultations with Players and YouTubers, I've decided to make gameplay harder. Now if Astronaut dies, you will lose Save.

Bugs fixed:
- Watermelon has the name.
- You can't insert a seed into a furnace.
- The camera moves faster.
- If player climbs up on a rock, he will see more than from the ground.


Optimization:
I've reduced some scripts and game should have got more FPS.

notes.title: Beta Update 1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29894218/df28330862bf1fe209df36ace129afe7e9b043cb.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
I've just released the First Beta Update.


The Farming System is fully ready and prepared for next update and extend its content(I mean new vegetables, Fertilizers etc.). Player uses Plant Pot, Fertilizer and Seeds.
Currently in the game are: Carrots, Potatoes, Onions, Lettuces, Tomatoes, Cucumbers, Watermelons.


In addition, I've added a Barbecue and a Kitchen Table. Astronaut is able to grill meat or fry fries now, but I promise you, there will be more to cook in new updates.

Every crafting recipe was described in Voxelaxy's Guide. You can read it [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1xkcV9RYxNeetPvMxd7jzf_n-c9p7vquC2QqiCpgxOfM]Here[/url] or click the second button in Menu in the game.

The menu was also changed. I've added buttons to Social Media, Autor's Board and the button "How to play"? - button to Voxelaxy's Guide, which I described above.




I did a ton of work on optimization and game works faster.
